description.zh:
加速类型，取值：
- play：播流加速。
- publish：推流加速。
description.en:
The acceleration type. Valid values:

- play: accelerates stream pulling.

- publish: accelerates stream ingest.

title.zh: 删除全球加速实例和直播链路的绑定关系

descriptions.zh:
解绑后，您的直播推拉流链路不再借助GA回源。解绑后加速实例仍然存在，如需释放加速实例需要在全球加速控制台上进行删除。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
After you detach the instance, your live stream ingest and stream pulling links no longer use Global Accelerator (GA) for origin fetch. The GA instance still exists after it is detached. To release the instance, delete it in the Global Accelerator console.

## QPS limit

The QPS limit for this API is 50 calls per second for each user. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your API calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-private-line --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --app-name live --stream-name testStream --acceleration-type play --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLivePrivateLine --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName testStream --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --AccelerationType play --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName live
